title: 第4章  明玉仙君
slug: 爹仙尊娘魔尊我嘎嘎乱杀
content_zh:
藏书塔。
藏书塔是玄天宗最多藏书的地方，此刻谢莲心正在藏书塔第三十六层翻阅着一本本厚厚的古籍。
她抱着一本古籍在旁边的大桌子上翻了几下，拿出了绘灵笔和纸在纸上勾勒出了一条条的灵力回路，在无数条灵力回路旁边标注起了各种术式。
写着写着陷入了瓶颈，苦恼地思索了起来。
如果要大量生产，必须简化灵力回路，可是简化了，又会让傀儡丧失智力、敏捷性、机动性等性能，该怎么调整呢？
想着想着，风一吹，那写得密密麻麻的纸飞了出去，被一只修长的手接住了。
这个时候，谢莲心终于是回神了，她看向了来人。
这是个容貌堪称绝美的年轻男子，他青衣环佩，墨黑长发垂落在身后，肌肤如同白玉，气质高雅修洁，如同芝兰玉树一般。他有着一双碧色的眼眸，那双眼眸此刻正在看她画的那灵力回路图。
谢莲心看到这青衣男子先是愣了一下，对方容貌太出众了，两辈子这么好看的男子，她也没见过几个。
他是谁？
此人身上仙气浓郁，显然已经成仙了，但谢莲心从未在玄天宗见过此人。
很快的她就出言道：“还给我。”
青衣男子没有立刻还给她，他又看了几眼，才抬头，他俊美的面容上带着春风拂面似的微笑：“真是巧夺天工的构思，按照这方法，说不定能炼制出大乘期的傀儡，这是你想出来的吗？太不可思议了！”
“你谁啊？”谢莲心道。
青衣男子温柔地笑道：
“逍遥宫，苏珩。”
他笑容温润，恍若十里桃花盛开。
苏珩，谢莲心听过这名字，他算是仙盟中最有名的高手之一了，只是前世没跟此人碰过面。她崛起之时，此人就已经陨落了。至于他陨落的原因，谢莲心因为前世跟他没有交集，所以没有去深究，不得而知。
前世曾听人说他当得上绝世无双四个字，今日一见，还真觉得当得起这四个字。
“原来是明玉仙君啊，晚辈谢莲心见过仙君！”谢莲心拱手道。

苏珩字明玉，众人皆称呼他为明玉仙君。
“原来你就是玉阳仙尊的大弟子啊，莲心仙子的名声我可是早就听说过了。”苏珩笑道。
“你听到的是我的坏话吗？”谢莲心问。
苏珩一愣，旋即笑出声来：“莲心仙子真是有趣。”
谢莲心不觉得哪里有趣，不过这家伙笑起来的样子还挺好看的，好似梨花白雪，清雅绝俗。
谢莲心看着他俊美无俦的脸说：“我记得这藏书塔不让外人进的，仙君是怎么进来的？”
苏珩笑道：“我说是偷偷溜进来的，仙子信吗？”
谢莲心：“……”
一般情况下，这里确实不让外人进的，但也有特殊情况的。比如说仙盟的友好门派的强者，如果是他们想要进来看看，肯定会破例。除了最顶层的藏书，其他地方都可以参阅。
“这炼金傀儡的灵力回路，仙子怎么想出来的？”苏珩的语气里有怀疑，也难怪他有怀疑。谢莲心虽然是有名的绝世天才，可是她也才十四啊，怎么可能想得出来这样的灵力回路设计。
谢莲心道：“我师尊想的。”
这也不算撒谎，她的创新的傀儡灵力回路设计，本来就是借鉴了她父亲谢逸的手稿，然后自己又继续创新了。
“玉阳仙尊果真是无双天才！”苏珩钦佩地道。
说话间，有气息靠近了。
苏珩扭头看向了身后，谢莲心将那草稿收了。接着看到了两道身影走来，这是两个女子，都穿着白衣。
一个年长一些，看着二十三四岁的样子，容貌冷艳，长发全部用簪子绾起，戴着翡翠色的耳坠子，眉心有菱形印记，手臂上挽着轻纱披帛，气质清冷孤傲。
另一个是个少女，这少女也就是十七八岁的样子，容貌绝色又楚楚可怜，她披着白纱衣，身段婀娜丝风中弱柳，让人无限怜惜。
那年长的是谢莲心的师叔韩素雪，那少女正是她师妹柳如烟。
韩素雪是玉雪峰的峰主，也是谢逸的师妹，她一直仰慕师兄谢逸，但谢逸却一直不接受她。这玄天宗里面，其实有不少人猜测到了谢莲心和谢逸是父女，韩素雪就是其中之一，因此前世，她就一直针对谢莲心。
针对这个情敌的女儿。

她跟柳如烟关系很好，据说她跟柳如烟的母亲是好友。
谢莲心一直不懂，竟然是好友，她为什么不干脆收柳如烟为徒呢？故意膈应自己，还是想在玉阳峰插个眼线啊？
“韩道友。”
苏珩先打招呼了。
韩素雪回礼：“苏道友原来在这里啊，你逍遥宫的两位长老才说要去找你呢。”
苏珩笑道：“就走了。”
说着他看向了旁边的柳如烟，柳如烟第一次见苏珩也甚是好奇这位陌生又俊美无双的前辈，见苏珩看向自己，忙朝着苏珩一拜，温声细语地行礼：“如烟见过前辈。”
“这位是玉阳师兄的小徒弟，柳如烟。”韩素雪看向柳如烟微微露出点笑容。
“原来是柳仙子，真是巧了，刚刚才认识了莲心仙子，现在又见到了柳仙子。”苏珩说话的时候，看了眼旁边的谢莲心。
韩素雪的目光也看过来，看到谢莲心的脸，她的目光就冷了：“见了师叔连行礼都不会了吗？大师兄就是太骄纵你了。”
谢莲心压着火气，微笑行礼：
“莲心见过师叔。”
“我不在玄天宗这段时间，听说你将烟儿打成了重伤，好狠毒，烟儿可是你师妹啊。大师兄风光霁月，怎么教出了你这样的徒弟来？”韩素雪看谢莲心就仿佛看到了另一个人，所以她看谢莲心哪里都不顺眼的。
谢莲心道：“师叔，那是切磋不小心的。切磋难免有失手，就好像师妹不小心就打碎了我的灵兽蛋一样。”
韩素雪冷笑道：“灵兽蛋？好啊，原来是蓄意报复。”
谢莲心：“……”
这女人就是故意挑刺的，一个得道仙人来针对她一个元婴修士，还当着外人的面呢，她也不嫌丢了自己身份。
柳如烟站出来，望着韩素雪，语音柔弱又婉转：“师叔，师姐不是故意的，这事情已经过去了，您不要为了烟儿再为难师姐了。”
“烟儿，你心地纯良，不懂有些人不惩处，是不会长记性的。”韩素雪冷冷地看着说，目光看着谢莲心。
content_en:
Library tower.
The library tower is the place where Xuantian Sect has the largest collection of books. At this moment, Xie Lianxin is reading through thick ancient books on the 36th floor of the library tower.
She held an ancient book and flipped through it a few times on the big table next to her. She took out a spiritual pen and paper and sketched out spiritual circuits on the paper. She marked various spells next to the countless spiritual circuits.
I got stuck in a bottleneck as I wrote and began to think distressedly.
If mass production is to be carried out, the spiritual power circuit must be simplified. However, if simplified, the puppet will lose its intelligence, agility, mobility and other properties. How to adjust it?
After thinking about it, when the wind blew, the densely written paper flew out and was caught by a slender hand.
At this time, Xie Lianxin finally came to her senses, and she looked at the person.
This is a young man with an extremely beautiful appearance. He wears a green robe, long black hair hanging down behind his back, his skin is like white jade, and his temperament is elegant and clean, just like the orchid orchid tree. He has a pair of green eyes, which are currently looking at the spiritual circuit diagram she drew.
Xie Lianxin was stunned for a moment when she saw the man in green. His appearance was so outstanding. She had never seen many such good-looking men in her two lifetimes.
who is he?
This person has a strong immortal energy and has obviously become an immortal, but Xie Lianxin has never seen this person in Xuantian Sect.
She quickly said: "Give it back to me."
The man in green didn't return it to her immediately. He looked at it a few more times and then looked up. There was a smile like a spring breeze on his handsome face: "What an ingenious idea. According to this method, maybe you can make a puppet of the Mahayana stage. Did you come up with this? It's incredible!"
"Who are you?" Xie Lian asked in her heart.
The man in green smiled softly and said:
"Xiaoyao Palace, Su Heng."
His smile was warm, as if peach blossoms were in full bloom.
Su Heng, Xie Lianxin has heard of this name. He is considered one of the most famous masters in the Immortal League, but he has never met this person in his previous life. When she rose, this man had already fallen. As for the reason for his death, Xie Lianxin did not know it because she had no interaction with him in her previous life, so she did not delve into it.
In my previous life, I had heard people say that he was worthy of being peerless. When I saw him today, I really felt that he was worthy of these four words.
"It turns out to be Immortal Lord Mingyu. Junior Xie Lianxin has met the Immortal Lord!" Xie Lianxin cupped her hands and said.
Su Heng's nickname is Mingyu, and everyone calls him Mingyu Immortal Lord.
"So you are the eldest disciple of Yuyang Immortal Lord. I have heard of the reputation of Fairy Lotus Heart for a long time." Su Heng said with a smile.
"Did you hear bad words about me?" Xie Lianxin asked.
Su Heng was stunned for a moment, then laughed out loud: "Fairy Lotus Heart is really interesting."
Xie Lianxin didn't think it was funny, but this guy's smile was pretty good-looking, like pear blossoms and white snow, elegant and elegant.
Xie Lianxin looked at his handsome face and said, "I remember that outsiders are not allowed to enter this library tower. How did the Immortal Lord get in?"
Su Heng smiled and said: "I said I sneaked in secretly, do you believe me?"
Xie Lianxin: "..."
Under normal circumstances, outsiders are not allowed to enter here, but there are also special circumstances. For example, if powerful men from friendly sects in the Immortal Alliance want to come in and take a look, they will definitely make an exception. Except for the topmost collection of books, you can refer to them elsewhere.
"How did the fairy come up with the spiritual power circuit of this alchemy puppet?" There was doubt in Su Heng's tone. No wonder he was doubtful. Although Xie Lianxin is a famous genius, she is only fourteen. How could she possibly come up with such a spiritual circuit design.
Xie Lian said in her heart: "My master thought about it."
This is not a lie. Her innovative puppet spiritual circuit design was originally based on her father Xie Yi's manuscript, and then she continued to innovate.
"Immortal Yuyang is really an unparalleled genius!" Su Heng said with admiration.
As he spoke, a breath came closer.
Su Heng turned to lookTurning behind her, Xie Lianxin put away the draft. Then I saw two figures approaching. They were two women, both wearing white clothes.
One is older, looks to be in his mid-twenties, has a cool face, his long hair is tied up with hairpins, he wears emerald earrings, there is a diamond-shaped mark between his eyebrows, he has a gauze shawl on his arm, and he has a cold and aloof temperament.
The other is a girl. This girl is about seventeen or eighteen years old. Her appearance is stunning and pitiful. She is wearing a white gauze dress and her figure is graceful and frail in the wind, which makes people feel infinite pity.
The elder was Xie Lianxin's junior uncle Han Suxue, and the girl was her junior sister Liu Ruyan.
Han Suxue is the peak master of Yuxue Peak and Xie Yi's junior sister. She has always admired her senior brother Xie Yi, but Xie Yi has never accepted her. In the Xuantian Sect, many people actually guessed that Xie Lianxin and Xie Yi were father and daughter, and Han Suxue was one of them. Therefore, she had been targeting Xie Lianxin in her previous life.
Targeting this love rival's daughter.
She has a very good relationship with Liu Ruyan. It is said that she is good friends with Liu Ruyan's mother.
Xie Lianxin never understood that they were actually good friends. Why didn't she just accept Liu Ruyan as her disciple? Are you deliberately trying to spite yourself, or do you want to be an informant at Yuyang Peak?
"Fellow Daoist Han."
Su Heng said hello first.
Han Suxue returned the greeting: "Fellow Daoist Su is here, and the two elders from your Xiaoyao Palace said they wanted to find you."
Su Heng smiled and said, "Just leave."
As he spoke, he looked at Liu Ruyan next to him. Liu Ruyan saw Su Heng for the first time and was very curious about this strange and handsome senior. Seeing Su Heng looking at him, he hurriedly bowed to Su Heng and saluted in a gentle voice: "Ruyan has met senior."
"This is Senior Brother Yuyang's young apprentice, Liu Ruyan." Han Suxue looked at Liu Ruyan and smiled slightly.
"It turns out to be Fairy Liu. What a coincidence. I just met Fairy Lianxin, and now I meet Fairy Liu again." When Su Heng spoke, he glanced at Xie Lianxin beside him.
Han Suxue also looked over, and when she saw Xie Lianxin's face, her eyes became cold: "You can't even salute when you meet your senior uncle? Senior brother is just too arrogant and indulgent of you."
Xie Lian suppressed her anger and saluted with a smile:
"Lian Xin has met Uncle Master."
"While I was away from the Xuantian Sect, I heard that you beat Yan'er seriously and was so cruel. Yan'er is your junior sister. How could Senior Brother Feng Jiyue teach a disciple like you?" Han Suxue looked at Xie Lianxin as if she was seeing another person, so she didn't like anything about Xie Lianxin.
Xie Lian said in her heart: "Uncle, you were careless in the sparring. It is inevitable to make mistakes in sparring, just like junior sister accidentally broke my spirit beast egg."
Han Suxue sneered: "Spiritual beast egg? Okay, it turns out it was deliberate revenge."
Xie Lianxin: "..."
This woman was deliberately making trouble. A Taoist immortal came to target her, a Yuanying monk, in front of outsiders. She didn't mind losing her identity.
Liu Ruyan stood up, looked at Han Suxue, and spoke softly and tactfully: "Uncle, senior sister didn't mean it. This matter has passed. Don't embarrass senior sister again because of Yan'er."
"Yan'er, you have a pure heart and don't understand that some people will not have long memories if they are not punished." Han Suxue said coldly, looking at Xie Lianxin.
